newsitem.title: USA: Oceaneering sees gain on sale of producer.
newsitem.headline: Oceaneering sees gain on sale of producer.

text.p: Oceaneering International Inc said on Monday that Mobil Corp's Mobil Equatorial Guinea Inc was exercising its option to purchase the Zafiro Producer, and that Oceaneering would post an after-tax gain of about $16 million on the sale.

Mobil will assume ownership of the floating production, storage and offloading system in December 1996, and Oceaneering said it will continue to operate the system on behalf of Mobil under an operating management agreement.

The company said it will use the proceeds from the deal to retire long-term debt - presently estimated at around $70 milion - and for general corporate purposes including the funding of its remotely operated vehicle fleet expansion.
